notes: threeview.py --list 的元素清单示例：一次调用出 6 个不同场景元素的三视图。
对应教程《HD-2D场景搭建/批量生图提示词.txt》的「分解参考图」与
《HD-3D场景生成/模型生成提示词.txt》的「分解三视图」两段——都是一份清单 → 逐个元素出图。
关键点：styles 按 kind 分组。默认 style 写死「anime game character … full body」，
拿它出树/岩石/建筑会稳定出成人形，所以每个 kind 都要有自己的 style。
kind 还决定用哪套措辞与视图：character → front/side/back；其余 → 正交 front/side/top。
速率：--sleep 控制元素间隔（默认 5 秒），别设 0。
attempts 定 3：实测同一元素单次成功不稳（同一份提示词跑两轮，岩石一次 3 段一次 2 段），重试是独立采样，比调提示词更管用。

styles.character: anime game character, cel shaded, full body, no background props
styles.tree: stylized low-poly game asset, a single deciduous tree, clean readable silhouette, flat cel shaded colors, no grass, no rocks, no extra objects
styles.rock: stylized low-poly game asset, a single weathered boulder, chunky faceted surfaces, flat cel shaded colors, no grass, no extra objects
styles.building: stylized low-poly game asset, a small single-story house with a pitched roof and one door, flat cel shaded colors, no fence, no trees, no extra objects
styles.grass: stylized low-poly game asset, a single small tuft of grass, flat cel shaded green, nothing else in frame
styles.lamp: stylized low-poly game asset, a single old street lamp post with a round lantern head, flat cel shaded colors, nothing else in frame
